prompt: I've written a spec for webhook retry support at docs/specs/webhook-retry-spec.md — can you break it down into an ordered task list? Some of it can probably be done in parallel across agents.
assertions: plan.md and todo.md are created in docs/specs/ (next to webhook-retry-spec.md), not in a default/other location
All task ids match T-XXX (zero-padded 3 digits) and increment sequentially from T-001
Every task has a dedicated Deps: line containing only task ids or 'none' (no trailing text, no other fields)
Every task has Size: on its own line with value XS/S/M/L (no XL)
Every task has Risk: on its own line with value S/M/L/XL
All Deps references point to existing tasks and the dependency graph is acyclic
Tasks editing the shared config src/config/index.ts are serialized via Deps edges
plan.md contains a dependency graph, phases with checkpoints, and a risks/mitigations section
